entry.title: Castel Nuovo

terrainReference.basis: Standard viewer PMTiles sample; reconstructed floors.

entry.note: Inspected picture confirms flat crenellated dark towers, corbelled crowns, warm curtain walls and pale stacked entrance arch. Retained mapped tower-footing/court geometry and standard viewer PMTiles set approximate location, scale and western-entry orientation. A reconstructed1m working rise keeps court and entry above coarse sampled ground; bounded tower-footing bottoms extend beneath terrain. Anchor 14.253249701,40.838300344; heading -0.308685078188; standard PMTiles datum 15.497152127096433m. Floors are reconstructed and foundations extend below the coarse sampled ground. Preview uses the host terrain sample at the authored base; ground slope, facade azimuth and final site fit remain review items.

review: Explicit authoring proposal; registration is not geographic or maximum-fidelity approval.
